column1: # The dice's pips (geom/shape/pip.rs): which face shows which value, and
# where its pips sit on the face's 3 x 3 grid (u,v each -1, 0 or 1; the grid
# step is the shape's spread). Opposite faces sum to 7.
# face: the axis the face looks along (+x -x +y -y +z -z); u and v are the
# next two axes in turn (x: y z, y: z x, z: x y).
